goals.easy:
Goal: Remove the lid, remember the dim sum order as you unstack the baskets from top to bottom onto the table or wooden board, then restack them in the same order from bottom to top on the left steamer pot and replace the lid.

TASK RECIPE:
3 target baskets; no distractors.

Remove the lid and dismantle the target baskets from top to bottom. The scene has only a wooden board on the table: a removed basket may rest at any stable position on the table or board. No mat, assigned drop location or landing region is scored. Rebuild the original vertical order from bottom to top on the left steamer pot, replace the lid and leave the released stack stable for three seconds. The preplaced empty base is not a target and the lid is not part of the order. Each transport requires a real same-arm two-finger grasp and measured lift of at least 3 cm. Rebuilt placement tolerances remain XY <= 10 mm, Z <= 3 mm, tilt <= 5 degrees; final three-second displacement <= 0.5 mm. Judge Hard by the terminal stack on the left pot: exactly the target baskets in their original order, with the lid replaced. A distractor in the stack is misplaced and receives no correct-target placement credit. Prior distractor motion or contact does not independently affect scoring.

Scoring (highest eligible stage; stages are not added):
0: Incomplete valid dismantling or no eligible stage.
10: The lid and every target basket have been validly dismantled from top to bottom and released on the table or board.
20: After dismantling, a continuous correct bottom prefix of at least half the target baskets (rounded up) is restored, released, supported and within placement tolerance.
30: Every target basket is correctly restored and released within placement tolerance, but the lid or final stability/finish conditions are incomplete.
100: Valid dismantling, original-order restoration, lid replacement, release, contact and three-second stability all pass; The terminal stack contains exactly the target baskets and lid.
